status: development-trial; CPU validated, GPU integration pending

model.combination: F0*A + F90*B; coefficients are single scattering; retain existing r180 multiple scattering
model.NdotVZero: evaluate positive grazing limit at 1e-05, except exact mirror corner uses Fresnel limit
model.numericalGuard: Stable analytic VNDF ratio; excludes direct-light GLSL EPSILON=1e-6 denominator floor. Differences quantified in validation; no legacy-domain fallback.

generation.method: Heitz 2018 VNDF + correlated G2/G1; independently shifted Hammersley
